title: Nanha sa ek sar
body:
Nanha sa ek sar
JAB Shimr-e-Laen(L.a.) SHOHDA(a.s.) KAY SAR KAAT KAY LAAYA
SHOHDA(s.a.) KAY SARO'N KO Pisar-e-Sa'ad(L.a.) NAY DAIKHA
SAR ASGHAR-E-MA'ASOOM(a.s.) KA MOJOOD NAHI'N THA
YEH KEHTAY HUWAY Shimr(L.a.) KO PAAS APNAY BULAYA
Hakim(L.a.) MUJHAY BAKHSHAY GA NAHI'N TUJH KO KHABAR HAI
JA DHOOND SAR-E-ASGHAR-E-MA'ASOOM(a.s.) KIDHAR HAI
TAREEKH MEIN IS ZULM KA MILTA HAI HAWALA
ZALIM(L.a.) NAY LAHAD KHOD KAY ASGHAR(a.s.) KO NIKAALA
SAR KAAT CHUKA KHOOLI TO NAIZA KO SANBHALA
NAIZAY PEH GAYA BAANO(s.a.) KI AAGHOSH KA PAALA
MOT BHI NOHA KARTI THI ROKAR
BIGRHA HAI BAANO(s.a.) TERA MUQADDAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
JO SAAHIB-E-AULAD HAI SOCHAY TO ZARA SA
KIS DARJA SITAM KOKH JALI MAA'N PEH HUWA THA
GHASH KHAAI HUWI MAA'N NAY JO'NHI AANKHO'N KO KHOLA
NAIZAY PEH SAR-E-ASGHAR-E-MA'ASOOM(a.s.) KO DAIKHA
THAAMAY KALEJA BOLI WOH MAADAR
SAANI-E-ZEHRA(s.a.) DEKHO YEH MANZAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAINAB(s.a.) NAY SOO-E-LASHKAR-E-A'ADA(L.a.) KO NAZAR KI
SAR PEET KAY YEH KEHNAY LAGI WOH DARD KI MAARI
AEY KUSHTA-E-SHAMSHEER-E-JAFA AAEY MERAY BHAI(a.s.)
KIA BA'AD-E-SHAHADAT BHI SITAM HOTA HAI KOI?
TU HI BATA AEY SABR KAY PAIKAR
KAISAY SANBHALAY DIL KO YEH MADAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
KIYA ZULM MERAY BACHAY PEH HAI DAIKH KHUDAYA
NA JHOOLAY MEIN PAAY NA SUKOO'N QABR MEIN PAAYA
MAA'N ROTI HAI YEH KEH KE KAHA'N DOODH BARHHAAYA
PANI KAY IWAZ TEER-E-SITAM HALQ PEH KHAAYA
PIYASA GAYA THA DUNIYA SAY ASGHAR(a.s.)
AB YEH SITAM HAI KHALIQ-E-AKBAR(j.j.)
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
PHIR KEHNAY LAGI MAADAR-E-AKBAR(a.s.) SAY LIPAT KAR
ATHHARA BARAS JEE TO GAYA THA TERA DILBAR
KHOO'N TUJH KO RULATI HAI MAGAR FURQAT-E-AKBAR(a.s.)
AB SOCH KE KIYA BEET GAI HAI MERAY DIL PAR
GOD MEIN JIS KO LAY GAEY SARWAR(a.s.)
DIKH RAHI HOO'N AAJ YEH MANZAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
SHABBIR(a.s.) NAY DAIKHA JO SINA'N PAR SAR-E-ASGHAR(a.s.)
EIK BAAR NIGAAHO'N SAY KIYA SAJDAH ZAMEE'N PAR PHIR BOLAY NIGAHO'N KO UTHAEY HUWAY SARWAR
TU RAAZI TO MAIN RAAZI MERAY KHALIQ-E-AKBAR(j.j.)
WA'ADA NIBHAAYA GHAR KO LUTA KAR
AB YEH SITAM BHI SEHTA HOO'N DIL PAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
AKBAR(a.s.) SAY KAHA SHEH(a.s.) NAY MERAY LA'AL TERAY BA'AD
ZAINAB(s.a.) KA HUWA GHAM SAY BURA HAAL TERAY BA'AD
THAY KHAAK MEIN AALOODAH MERAY BAAL TERAY BA'AD
A'ADA NAY KIYA LAASHO'N KO PAAMAAL TERAY BA'AD
YEH BHI QAYAMAT AEY MERAY DILBAR
DAIKH SAKO TO DAIKH LO AAKAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
SAJJAD(a.s.) TARHAPNAY LAGAY BABA(a.s.) KI FUGHA'N PAR
BAQAR(a.s.) KAY SAHARAY SAY UTHAY YA ALI(a.s.) KEH KAR
ROKAR YEH SAKINA(s.a.) SAY KAHA AYE MERI KHUWAHAR
KIA TUM NAY SUNA BABA(a.s.) JO FARMATAY HAIN ROKAR
BOLI SAKINA(s.a.) MERAY BARADAR(a.s.)
BHAI(a.s.) SAY BABA(a.s.) KEHTAY HAI ROKAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
''FARHAN'' LAHOO ROTAY HUWAY LIKHTA HAI ''MAZHAR''
DORAAN-E-SAFAR GHAZI(a.s.) SAY FARMATAY THAY SARWAR(s.a.)
TU HOTA TO YEH ZULM NAHIN HOTA BARADAR(a.s.)
FARIYAAD YEH HAI BAANO-E-DILGEER(s.a.) KAY LAB PAR
BAZOO-E-SHABBIR(a.s.) DAIKH TO AAKAR
HALQ HAI ZAKHMI KHAAK HAI SAR PAR
<<MINI>>
NOK-E-SINA'N PAR NANHA SA EIK SAR
LAYKAY CHALA HAI HAAEY SITAMGAR(L.a.)
